prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Pasadena, Texas, and has shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1351; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is about the sideswipe collision you were involved in while driving in Pasadena, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please state where you were heading and what you were doing right before the collision.

A: I was driving north on the main road, and I needed to move over one lane to get ready for my exit. I checked my mirror and it looked clear.

Q: Did you use your turn signal before you changed lanes?

A: Yes, I put my signal on and started to move over slowly. Then I heard a horn and felt a bump on my driver's side.

Q: Where was the other vehicle when you first noticed it?

A: It was in the lane I was moving into, a little behind me. I didn't see it when I checked the mirror. I think it was in my blind spot.

Q: Did the other driver say anything at the scene?

A: They said they didn't see me coming over, and then they asked if I was okay.

Q: Can you describe any injuries you have since the collision?

A: My right shoulder hurts a lot. I twisted it when I grabbed the wheel, and it's hard to lift my arm above my head. I went to urgent care that afternoon and they gave me a sling and told me to follow up with a doctor.

Q: Have you had any prior problems with that same shoulder?

A: No, not that I can remember. It has never bothered me like this before.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: I just want to make sure my side of things is on the record. I was signaling and I checked my mirror. I'm willing to provide any records from the urgent care visit.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.

A: Thank you.
